name: Dawn Regalia (Draknora signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} silk and gold-orange gauze, a fitted bodice embroidered with {{ACCENT_SOFT}} flames and phoenix feathers, a high swept collar of {{METAL}} flame-shaped plates, long layered sleeves ending in flame-cut points, and a skirt split into long burning ribbons that whip upward behind her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
